assets.caption: EXHIBIT 9-20 — Top Platform Arrangements. Composite of four hand-drawn sketches: (1) catalyst transfer hopper being lowered onto a portable hopper above a reactor head with adjacent support structure; (2) elevation showing thermal growth between reactor platform (hot/cold positions) and structure platform with '1/2 TOTAL GROWTH' dimension; (3) plan view of reactor top head with square platform, thermowell (TW), three typical connections, and an auxiliary connection, noting 'ALLOW ADEQUATE PLATFORM AREA FOR CATALYST LOADING OPERATION'; (4) elevation of reactor top with removable spool piece, flanges, and line support locations 'A' or 'B'.
